source.text: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־הָאֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב־מִפּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־אַמּֽוֹת־רֹ֥חַב מִפּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָאֹֽהֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought me to the temple, and he measured the jambs, six cubits breadth from here and six cubits breadth from here, [the] breadth of the tent.

en.L: Then he brought me to the hall, and he measured the jambs: six cubits wide here and six cubits wide there, the width of the tent.
en.B: Then he brought me into the main hall of the temple and measured the jambs. They were {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} thick on each side, the width of the tent.
en.R: Then he took me into the main room of the temple. He measured the side posts at its entrance. They were {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} thick on each side, the width of the tent.

fr.L: Puis il me fit entrer dans la grande salle, et il mesura les montants : six coudées de large d’un côté et six coudées de large de l’autre, la largeur de la tente.
fr.B: Puis il me fit entrer dans la grande salle du temple et mesura les montants : ils avaient {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} d’épaisseur de chaque côté, la largeur de la tente.
fr.R: Ensuite, il m’a fait entrer dans la salle principale du temple. Il a mesuré les piliers de l’entrée. Ils avaient {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} d’épaisseur de chaque côté, la largeur de la tente.

es.L: Y me llevó a la nave, y midió las jambas: seis codos de ancho de un lado y seis codos de ancho del otro lado, el ancho de la tienda.
es.B: Luego me llevó a la sala principal del templo y midió las jambas. Tenían {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de grosor a cada lado, el ancho de la tienda.
es.R: Después me llevó a la sala principal del templo. Midió los pilares de la entrada. Tenían {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de grosor a cada lado, el ancho de la tienda.

sw.L: Akanileta ukumbini, akaipima miimo: dhiraa sita upana upande huu, na dhiraa sita upana upande huu, [ndio] upana wa hema.
sw.B: Kisha akanileta ndani ya ukumbi mkuu wa hekalu, akaipima miimo. Unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}} kila upande, ndio upana wa hema.
sw.R: Kisha akanipeleka ndani ya chumba kikuu cha hekalu. Akapima nguzo za pembeni kwenye mlango wake. Unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}} kila upande, sawa na upana wa hema.

vi.L: Rồi người dẫn tôi đến gian chính, và người đo các trụ cửa: bề rộng sáu cu-đê bên này và bề rộng sáu cu-đê bên kia, [là] bề rộng của cái lều.
vi.B: Rồi người dẫn tôi vào chính điện của đền thờ và đo các trụ cửa. Mỗi bên dày {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}, bằng bề rộng của cái lều.
vi.R: Rồi người đưa tôi vào gian chính của đền thờ. Người đo các trụ cửa ở lối vào. Mỗi bên dày {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}, bằng bề rộng của cái lều.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 나를 본당으로 데리고 가서 벽기둥들을 쟀다. 이쪽 너비가 여섯 규빗, 저쪽 너비가 여섯 규빗이었으니, 장막의 너비였다.
ko.B: 그리고 그가 나를 성전 본당으로 데리고 들어가서 벽기둥을 쟀다. 벽기둥의 두께는 양쪽이 각각 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었으니, 장막의 너비였다.
ko.R: 그 사람이 나를 성전의 큰 방으로 데리고 들어갔다. 그는 입구의 옆 기둥들을 쟀다. 그 두께는 양쪽 다 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었는데, 장막의 너비였다.

decisions.choice: the hall: the main room of the temple building, the holy place
decisions.reason: The word can mean a palace or a temple as a whole, but here, as in 1 Kings 6:3, 5, 17, it is the large room between the porch and the inner room, where the lampstands and the table stood in Solomon's temple.

decisions.choice: the width of the tent: a puzzling phrase
decisions.reason: "Tent" may recall the tabernacle, whose frame was six cubits wide at the back in some reckonings, or it may be a copying slip for the word for "jamb". The Septuagint does not have it in this form. The translation keeps the received text.

decisions.choice: the hall (L); the main hall of the temple (B); the main room of the temple (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:3 and 6:17. The same English is used for this room through chapters 41-46.

decisions.choice: jambs (L, B); side posts (R)
decisions.reason: As in 40:9.

decisions.choice: chapters 41-48 continue Ezekiel's first-person vision report: narration in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("il me fit entrer", "il mesura", "il me dit"), passé composé at Readable ("il m'a fait entrer"); what the guide and God say is speech, in present, future and passé composé
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for Ezekiel's visions and frames; recorded once for chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: "la grande salle" (L, B, "la grande salle du temple") / "la salle principale du temple" (R) for the hekhal; "montants" (L, B) / "piliers" (R) for the jambs
decisions.reason: "La grande salle" is the word of the published 1 Kings 6 for the same room of Solomon's temple; the term sheet sets "montants" / "piliers" for 'elim, uncertain.

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}}: metric by default, worked out on the long cubit of 40:5 (about 53 cm; a reed of six long cubits about 3,20 m), the original units as the alternative; Literal keeps the cubits. Used throughout chapters 41-48
alternatives: US feet and inches as the English
the ordinary cubit of 45 cm used in 1 Kings 6
decisions.reason: French uses metric measures (style guide section 7); the figures follow the term sheet's table for Ezekiel 40-48.

decisions.choice: "la nave" (L); "la sala principal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Spanish of 1 Kings 6:3 already uses "la nave" at L and "la sala principal" at B and R for this room; Ezekiel's temple keeps the same words so that the two temples can be compared. The building as a whole is "la casa" at L and "el templo" at B and R, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "jambas" (L, B); "pilares de la entrada" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names the thick posts or wall ends on each side of an opening; its exact form is uncertain. "Jambas" is the building term; at R "pilares de la entrada" says plainly where they stand, as the English "side posts" does. Used throughout chapters 40 to 46.

decisions.choice: metric figures worked out on the long cubit: six cubits is "unos 3,2 metros"
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's measuring cubit is "a cubit and a handbreadth" (40:5), a long cubit of about 52.5 cm, so every unit span in chapters 40 to 48 is worked out on it: a cubit "unos 53 centímetros", five cubits "unos 2,6 metros", ten "unos 5,3 metros", twenty "unos 10,5 metros", 100 cubits "unos 53 metros", a reed "unos 3,2 metros". This is why the figures are larger than those of 1 Kings 6, which uses the common cubit. The alternative keeps the cubits, with numbers up to ninety-nine in words.

decisions.choice: ukumbi (Literal); ukumbi mkuu wa hekalu (Balanced); chumba kikuu cha hekalu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The main room of the temple (heikal) is named as in 1 Kings 6:3 and the term sheet for Ezekiel 40-48; the same words are used through chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: miimo (Literal, Balanced); nguzo za pembeni (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Miimo" are door-posts, as 1 Kings 6:31; Readable says "side posts" plainly, as the English Readable does. Used through chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: metres worked out on the long cubit (karibu mita 3.2 for six cubits), with the cubits in words as the alternative
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's measuring cubit is "a cubit and a handbreadth" (40:5), about 53 cm, so a reed of six such cubits is about 3.2 m. Swahili gives metres by default where the English gives feet, with "dhiraa" as the alternative; Literal keeps "dhiraa" with no span. These values hold through chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 3,2 m" (default) / "sáu cu-đê" (alternative): metres by default, worked out on the long cubit of about 53 cm
decisions.reason: In Ezekiel 40-48 the measuring cubit is "a cubit and a handbreadth" (40:5), the 45 cm cubit of the published Kings plus a handbreadth of about 7.5 cm, so about 53 cm, and the reed of six such cubits about 3.2 m. Every units span in chapters 41-48 is worked out on it, with a decimal comma; the alternative gives the cubits, in words up to ninety-nine and in figures from 100. Vietnamese measures in metres, not the English feet. Literal keeps the cubits and has no span.

decisions.choice: the guide is "người" in Ezekiel's narration; the heikhal is "gian chính" (L, R) / "chính điện" (B)
decisions.reason: The bronze man of 40:3 is a heavenly guide, not God, so the narration calls him "người" with no deity_pronoun span; when he speaks he says "tôi" and addresses Ezekiel as "Hỡi con người". The hall is named as in 1 Kings 6:17 ("chính điện"), with the plainer "gian chính" at Literal and Readable.

decisions.choice: Units in Ezekiel 40-48: metric spans in the form {{units:약 X|...}} at Balanced and Readable, worked out on the long cubit of about 53 cm ("약 3.2미터" for six cubits); Literal keeps the cubits ("여섯 규빗")
decisions.reason: The English converts to feet; Korean readers use metres, as in Kings. The guide's cubit is the long cubit of 40:5 (a cubit and a handbreadth, the English's 21 inches), about 53 cm, and the reed is six of them, about 3.2 m; every span in chapters 41-48 is worked out on it. The alternative writes the number in words up to ninety-nine and in figures from 100 (100규빗, 500갈대). The form with 약 follows Isaiah, Jeremiah and Ezra.

decisions.choice: "본당" (L); "성전 본당" (B); "성전의 큰 방" (R) for the hall; "벽기둥" (L, B) / "옆 기둥" (R) for the jambs
decisions.reason: The same room as Korean 1 Kings 6:3, 17 (본당 at L and B, 큰 방 at R); 성소 would blur it with the sanctuary as a whole. The jambs follow the term sheet's temple words.

source.text: וְרֹ֣חַב הַפֶּתַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְכִתְפ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אָרְכּוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] breadth of the entrance [was] ten cubits, and [the] sides of the entrance five cubits from here and five cubits from here; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and breadth twenty cubits.

en.L: And the entrance [was] ten cubits wide, and the sides of the entrance five cubits here and five cubits there; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and [its] width, twenty cubits.
en.B: The entrance was {{units:about 17 1/2 feet|ten cubits}} wide, and the walls on either side of it were {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} wide. He measured the main hall: it was {{units:about 70 feet|forty cubits}} long and {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide.
en.R: The doorway was {{units:about 17 1/2 feet|ten cubits}} wide. The walls on each side of it were {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} wide. He measured the main room. It was {{units:about 70 feet|forty cubits}} long and {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide.

fr.L: Et la largeur de l’entrée [était de] dix coudées, et les côtés de l’entrée, cinq coudées d’un côté et cinq coudées de l’autre ; et il mesura sa longueur : quarante coudées, et [sa] largeur : vingt coudées.
fr.B: L’entrée avait {{units:environ 5,35 mètres|dix coudées}} de large, et les murs de chaque côté avaient {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large. Il mesura la grande salle : elle avait {{units:environ 21,5 mètres|quarante coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large.
fr.R: La porte d’entrée avait {{units:environ 5,35 mètres|dix coudées}} de large. Les murs de chaque côté avaient {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large. Il a mesuré la salle principale. Elle avait {{units:environ 21,5 mètres|quarante coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large.

es.L: Y el ancho de la entrada [era] de diez codos, y los lados de la entrada, de cinco codos de un lado y cinco codos del otro; y midió su longitud, cuarenta codos, y [su] anchura, veinte codos.
es.B: La entrada tenía {{units:unos 5,3 metros|diez codos}} de ancho, y los muros a cada lado de ella tenían {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho. Midió la sala principal: tenía {{units:unos 21 metros|cuarenta codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho.
es.R: La entrada tenía {{units:unos 5,3 metros|diez codos}} de ancho. Los muros a cada lado tenían {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho. Midió la sala principal. Tenía {{units:unos 21 metros|cuarenta codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho.

sw.L: Na upana wa mlango [ulikuwa] dhiraa kumi, na pande za mlango dhiraa tano upande huu na dhiraa tano upande huu; akaupima urefu wake, dhiraa arobaini, na upana [wake], dhiraa ishirini.
sw.B: Mlango ulikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 5.3|dhiraa kumi}}, na kuta za kila upande wake zilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}}. Akaupima ukumbi mkuu: urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 21|dhiraa arobaini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}}.
sw.R: Mlango ulikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 5.3|dhiraa kumi}}. Kuta za kila upande wake zilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}}. Akakipima chumba kikuu. Kilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 21|dhiraa arobaini}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}}.

vi.L: Bề rộng của lối vào [là] mười cu-đê, và hai bên của lối vào năm cu-đê bên này và năm cu-đê bên kia; và người đo chiều dài của nó, bốn mươi cu-đê, và bề rộng, hai mươi cu-đê.
vi.B: Lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 5,3 m|mười cu-đê}}, và tường hai bên lối vào mỗi bên rộng {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}}. Người đo chính điện: dài {{units:khoảng 21 m|bốn mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 5,3 m|mười cu-đê}}. Tường mỗi bên lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}}. Người đo gian chính. Gian ấy dài {{units:khoảng 21 m|bốn mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 입구의 너비는 십 규빗이었고, 입구의 양옆은 이쪽이 다섯 규빗, 저쪽이 다섯 규빗이었다. 그리고 그가 그 길이를 재니 사십 규빗이었고, 너비는 이십 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 입구의 너비는 {{units:약 5.3미터|십 규빗}}이었고, 입구 양옆의 벽은 각각 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 그가 본당을 재니, 길이가 {{units:약 21미터|사십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 문간의 너비는 {{units:약 5.3미터|십 규빗}}이었다. 그 양옆의 벽은 각각 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 그가 큰 방을 재어 보니, 길이가 {{units:약 21미터|사십 규빗}}이고 너비가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: forty cubits by twenty: the size of the main hall of Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:2 and 6:17 give Solomon's main hall the same measures. Ezekiel's temple building keeps the plan of the first temple, while its courts and gates are new.

source.text: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל־הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְהַפֶּ֨תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֥חַב הַפֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went within and measured [the] jamb of the entrance, two cubits, and the entrance six cubits, and [the] breadth of the entrance seven cubits.

en.L: Then he went inside and measured the entrance's jamb, two cubits, and the entrance, six cubits, and the entrance's breadth, seven cubits.
en.B: Then he went into the inner room and measured the jambs of its entrance: they were {{units:about 3 1/2 feet|two cubits}} thick. The entrance was {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} wide, and its side walls were {{units:about 12 1/4 feet|seven cubits}} wide.
en.R: Then he went on into the inner room. He measured the side posts of its doorway. They were {{units:about 3 1/2 feet|two cubits}} thick. The doorway was {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} wide, and the walls on each side of it were {{units:about 12 1/4 feet|seven cubits}} wide.

fr.L: Puis il entra à l’intérieur et mesura le montant de l’entrée : deux coudées ; et l’entrée : six coudées ; et la largeur de l’entrée : sept coudées.
fr.B: Puis il entra dans la salle intérieure et mesura les montants de son entrée : ils avaient {{units:environ 1,05 mètre|deux coudées}} d’épaisseur. L’entrée avait {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} de large, et les murs de chaque côté avaient {{units:environ 3,75 mètres|sept coudées}} de large.
fr.R: Ensuite, il est entré dans la salle du fond. Il a mesuré les piliers de sa porte. Ils avaient {{units:environ 1,05 mètre|deux coudées}} d’épaisseur. La porte avait {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} de large, et les murs de chaque côté avaient {{units:environ 3,75 mètres|sept coudées}} de large.

es.L: Luego entró al interior y midió la jamba de la entrada, dos codos, y la entrada, seis codos, y la anchura de la entrada, siete codos.
es.B: Después entró en el cuarto interior y midió las jambas de su entrada: tenían {{units:algo más de 1 metro|dos codos}} de grosor. La entrada tenía {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de ancho, y sus muros laterales, {{units:unos 3,7 metros|siete codos}} de ancho.
es.R: Luego siguió hasta el cuarto interior. Midió los pilares de su entrada. Tenían {{units:algo más de 1 metro|dos codos}} de grosor. La entrada tenía {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de ancho, y los muros a cada lado tenían {{units:unos 3,7 metros|siete codos}} de ancho.

sw.L: Kisha akaingia ndani, akaupima mwimo wa mlango, dhiraa mbili, na mlango, dhiraa sita, na upana wa mlango, dhiraa saba.
sw.B: Kisha akaingia katika chumba cha ndani, akaipima miimo ya mlango wake: unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 1.1|dhiraa mbili}}. Mlango ulikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}}, na kuta za pembeni zake zilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 3.7|dhiraa saba}}.
sw.R: Kisha akaendelea mpaka chumba cha ndani. Akapima nguzo za pembeni za mlango wake. Unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 1.1|dhiraa mbili}}. Mlango ulikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}}, na kuta za kila upande wake zilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 3.7|dhiraa saba}}.

vi.L: Rồi người đi vào bên trong và đo trụ cửa của lối vào, hai cu-đê, và lối vào, sáu cu-đê, và bề rộng của lối vào, bảy cu-đê.
vi.B: Rồi người đi vào phòng trong và đo các trụ cửa ở lối vào: dày {{units:khoảng 1,1 m|hai cu-đê}}. Lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}, và tường hai bên lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 3,7 m|bảy cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Rồi người đi tiếp vào phòng trong. Người đo các trụ cửa ở lối vào. Các trụ ấy dày {{units:khoảng 1,1 m|hai cu-đê}}. Lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}, và tường mỗi bên lối vào rộng {{units:khoảng 3,7 m|bảy cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 안으로 들어가서 입구의 벽기둥을 재니 두 규빗이었고, 입구는 여섯 규빗, 입구의 너비는 일곱 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 그런 다음 그는 안쪽 방으로 들어가서 그 입구의 벽기둥을 쟀는데, 두께가 {{units:약 1.1미터|두 규빗}}이었다. 입구의 너비는 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었고, 그 양옆의 벽은 {{units:약 3.7미터|일곱 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 그다음에 그는 더 안쪽에 있는 방으로 들어갔다. 그는 그 문간의 옆 기둥들을 쟀다. 그 두께는 {{units:약 1.1미터|두 규빗}}이었다. 문간의 너비는 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었고, 양옆의 벽은 {{units:약 3.7미터|일곱 규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: he went inside: the man enters the inner room alone
decisions.reason: Ezekiel is brought into the main hall (verse 1), but the guide goes on into the inner room by himself. Only the high priest could enter the most holy place, once a year (Leviticus 16:2, 34), and Ezekiel, though a priest, does not follow.

decisions.choice: the entrance six cubits, and the breadth of the entrance seven: the opening and the walls beside it
decisions.reason: Six cubits is the width of the doorway; seven cubits is usually taken as the width of the wall on each side of it, as in verse 2, so that the front of the inner room is twenty cubits across (seven, six and seven). Others read the seven cubits as the depth of the doorway. The Hebrew is brief.

decisions.choice: into the inner room (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he went inside". Verse 4 shows that this is the inner room.

decisions.choice: "trụ cửa" for 'ayil (jamb) at every level
decisions.reason: The word used for the door frame in 1 Kings 6:31, kept for the same Hebrew through Ezekiel 40-48. What exactly the 'elim were (jambs, pilasters or projecting walls) is uncertain, as the English decision on this word says.

source.text: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־אָרְכּ֜וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he measured its length, twenty cubits, and breadth twenty cubits, to [the] face of the temple; and he said to me, This [is] [the] holy of holies.

en.L: And he measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, in front of the hall; and he said to me, "This [is] the holy of holies."
en.B: He measured the room beyond the main hall: it was {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide. He said to me, "This is the most holy place."
en.R: He measured the room at the far end of the main room. It was {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide. He said to me, "This is the most holy place."

fr.L: Et il mesura sa longueur : vingt coudées, et la largeur : vingt coudées, en face de la grande salle ; et il me dit : « Ceci [est] le saint des saints. »
fr.B: Il mesura la pièce qui se trouvait au-delà de la grande salle : elle avait {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large. Il me dit : « C’est le lieu très saint. »
fr.R: Il a mesuré la pièce qui se trouvait au fond de la salle principale. Elle avait {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large. Il m’a dit : « C’est le lieu très saint. »

es.L: Y midió su longitud, veinte codos, y la anchura, veinte codos, delante de la nave; y me dijo: «Este [es] el santo de los santos».
es.B: Midió el cuarto que está más allá de la sala principal: tenía {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho. Me dijo: «Este es el lugar santísimo».
es.R: Midió el cuarto que estaba al fondo de la sala principal. Tenía {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho. Me dijo: «Este es el lugar santísimo».

sw.L: Akaupima urefu wake, dhiraa ishirini, na upana, dhiraa ishirini, mbele ya ukumbi; akaniambia, "Hapa [ndipo] Patakatifu pa Patakatifu."
sw.B: Akakipima chumba kilichokuwa ng'ambo ya ukumbi mkuu: urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}}. Akaniambia, "Hapa ndipo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu."
sw.R: Akakipima chumba kilichokuwa mwisho wa chumba kikuu. Kilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}}. Akaniambia, "Hapa ndipo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu."

vi.L: Người đo chiều dài của nó, hai mươi cu-đê, và bề rộng, hai mươi cu-đê, ở phía trước gian chính; và người nói với tôi: "Đây [là] Nơi Chí Thánh."
vi.B: Người đo căn phòng phía sau chính điện: dài {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}. Người nói với tôi: "Đây là Nơi Chí Thánh."
vi.R: Người đo căn phòng ở cuối gian chính. Phòng ấy dài {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}. Người nói với tôi: "Đây là Nơi Chí Thánh."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 본당 앞쪽으로 그 길이를 재니 이십 규빗, 너비가 이십 규빗이었다. 그리고 그가 나에게 말했다. "이곳은 지극히 거룩한 곳이다."
ko.B: 그가 본당 너머에 있는 방을 재니, 길이가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이었다. 그가 나에게 말했다. "이곳이 지성소이다."
ko.R: 그가 큰 방 맨 안쪽에 있는 방을 재어 보니, 길이가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이고 너비도 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이었다. 그가 나에게 말했다. "이곳이 가장 거룩한 곳이다."

decisions.choice: the holy of holies: the most holy place, where the LORD's presence dwells
decisions.reason: The phrase means "the holiest place". In the tabernacle and in Solomon's temple it held the ark of the covenant beneath the cherubim (Exodus 26:33-34; 1 Kings 8:6). Ezekiel's temple names no ark; the LORD's glory itself fills the house (43:5). Hebrews 9:3-12 speaks of this room.

decisions.choice: twenty cubits by twenty: a perfect square, as in Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:20 gives the inner room of Solomon's temple the same measures, a cube twenty cubits on every side.

decisions.choice: the holy of holies (L); the most holy place (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:16.

decisions.choice: "el santo de los santos" (L); "el lugar santísimo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The published Spanish of Exodus 26:33 and 1 Kings 6:16 uses these words at the same levels.

decisions.choice: Patakatifu pa Patakatifu (every level)
decisions.reason: The Swahili phrase is already the Hebrew "holy of holies" word for word and is the published name of the inner room (1 Kings 6:16), so Literal, Balanced and Readable share it where the English Literal and Balanced differ.

decisions.choice: "Nơi Chí Thánh" at Literal too
decisions.reason: "Chí thánh" already says "holiest", which is what the Hebrew construction "holy of holies" means; a word-for-word phrase is not Vietnamese. Capitalised as in 1 Kings 6:16.

decisions.choice: "지극히 거룩한 곳" (L); "지성소" (B); "가장 거룩한 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean 1 Kings 6:16 names the room 지성소, 곧 가장 거룩한 곳. Literal keeps the superlative as a phrase, Balanced uses the established name, and Readable says it in plain words.

decisions.choice: The guide ("the man") takes no honorific: "그가 나에게 말했다", and he speaks in 해라체
decisions.reason: The man with the measuring reed is a heavenly messenger, not God; the English gives him no deity span, so Korean keeps him in the plain style. Only where the English marks God himself speaking does the narration switch to the honorific.

source.text: וַיָּ֥מָד קִֽיר־הַבַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְרֹ֣חַב הַצֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב׀סָבִ֛יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he measured [the] wall of the house, six cubits, and [the] breadth of the side chamber four cubits all around all around the house all around.

en.L: And he measured the wall of the house, six cubits [thick], and the width of the side chamber, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
en.B: Then he measured the wall of the temple: it was {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} thick. The side rooms all around the temple were each {{units:about 7 feet|four cubits}} wide.
en.R: Then he measured the wall of the temple. It was {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}} thick. Along the outside of the wall, all around the temple, there were side rooms. Each was {{units:about 7 feet|four cubits}} wide.

fr.L: Et il mesura le mur de la maison : six coudées [d’épaisseur] ; et la largeur de la chambre latérale : quatre coudées, tout autour de la maison, de tous côtés.
fr.B: Puis il mesura le mur du temple : il avait {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} d’épaisseur. Les chambres latérales, tout autour du temple, avaient chacune {{units:environ 2,15 mètres|quatre coudées}} de large.
fr.R: Ensuite, il a mesuré le mur du temple. Il avait {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}} d’épaisseur. Contre l’extérieur du mur, tout autour du temple, il y avait des chambres latérales. Chacune avait {{units:environ 2,15 mètres|quatre coudées}} de large.

es.L: Y midió el muro de la casa, seis codos [de grosor], y la anchura de la cámara lateral, cuatro codos, alrededor de la casa por todos lados.
es.B: Luego midió el muro del templo: tenía {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de grosor. Los cuartos laterales que rodeaban el templo tenían cada uno {{units:unos 2,1 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho.
es.R: Luego midió el muro del templo. Tenía {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}} de grosor. Por fuera del muro, alrededor de todo el templo, había cuartos laterales. Cada uno tenía {{units:unos 2,1 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho.

sw.L: Akaupima ukuta wa nyumba, dhiraa sita [unene], na upana wa chumba cha pembeni, dhiraa nne, kuizunguka nyumba pande zote.
sw.B: Kisha akaupima ukuta wa hekalu: unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}}. Vyumba vya pembeni vilivyolizunguka hekalu pande zote kila kimoja kilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.1|dhiraa nne}}.
sw.R: Kisha akaupima ukuta wa hekalu. Unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}}. Nje ya ukuta huo, kuzunguka hekalu lote, kulikuwa na vyumba vya pembeni. Kila kimoja kilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.1|dhiraa nne}}.

vi.L: Người đo tường của nhà, sáu cu-đê, và bề rộng của phòng phụ, bốn cu-đê, chung quanh nhà, khắp chung quanh.
vi.B: Rồi người đo tường đền thờ: dày {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}. Các phòng phụ chung quanh đền thờ mỗi phòng rộng {{units:khoảng 2,1 m|bốn cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Rồi người đo tường đền thờ. Tường dày {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}. Dọc theo mặt ngoài tường, chung quanh đền thờ, có các phòng phụ. Mỗi phòng rộng {{units:khoảng 2,1 m|bốn cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 집의 벽을 재니 [두께가] 여섯 규빗이었고, 곁방의 너비는 네 규빗이었는데, 그 집 둘레 사방으로 [그러했다].
ko.B: 그다음에 그가 성전 벽을 재니, 두께가 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었다. 성전을 빙 둘러 있는 곁방들은 너비가 각각 {{units:약 2.1미터|네 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 그다음에 그는 성전 벽을 쟀다. 그 두께는 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었다. 성전 벽 바깥쪽으로는 빙 둘러 곁방들이 있었다. 곁방은 너비가 각각 {{units:약 2.1미터|네 규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: side chamber: one of the small rooms built against the outside of the temple walls
decisions.reason: The word means "rib" or "side". 1 Kings 6:5-8 uses it for the rooms in several stories built around Solomon's temple, used for storage.

decisions.choice: side chamber (L); side rooms (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:5. The same English is used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "chambre latérale" at every level
decisions.reason: The word of the published 1 Kings 6:5 for the same rooms built against Solomon's temple.

decisions.choice: "cámara lateral" (L); "cuartos laterales" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:5, where the published Spanish has "cámaras laterales" at L and "cuartos laterales" at B. "Sala" and "cámara" alone are kept for the priests' rooms (lishkah), so the two kinds of room stay apart.

decisions.choice: nyumba (Literal); hekalu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Where "the house" names the temple building, Literal keeps "nyumba" and Balanced and Readable say "hekalu", as in 1 Kings 6 and the term sheet; used through chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: chumba cha pembeni, vyumba vya pembeni (side rooms); vyumba (the rooms, leshakhot)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:5, the small rooms built against the temple wall are "vyumba vya pembeni"; the priests' rooms of verse 10 and chapter 42 are plain "vyumba".

decisions.choice: "nhà" (L) / "đền thờ" (B, R) for the house; "phòng phụ" for the side chamber
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "house"; Balanced and Readable say what the house is, as the English does. "Phòng phụ" is the word of 1 Kings 6:5 for the same rooms in Solomon's temple.

decisions.choice: "그 집" (L) / "성전" (B, R) for the house; "곁방" for the side chambers at every level
decisions.reason: The vision calls the temple "the house"; Literal keeps the word, and Balanced and Readable name the building, as Korean 1 Kings 6 does. 곁방 is the word of 1 Kings 6:5 for the rooms built against its walls.

source.text: וְהַצְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל־צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠בָאוֹת בַּקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּ֧יִת לַצְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀סָבִ֖יב לִהְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּקִ֥יר הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the side chambers, side chamber on side chamber, three and thirty times; and [there were] going in in the wall which [was] to the house for the side chambers all around all around, to be supports, and not to be supports in [the] wall of the house.

en.L: And the side chambers [were] side chamber above side chamber, three [stories], and thirty in each story; and [there were ledges] going into the wall that [belonged] to the house for the side chambers all around, to be supports, so that they would not be supported in the wall of the house.
en.B: The side rooms were in three stories, one above another, thirty on each story. The wall of the temple had ledges all around to hold up the side rooms, so that their beams did not have to be set into the wall of the temple itself.
en.R: The side rooms were built in three levels, one on top of another. There were thirty rooms on each level. The temple wall had ledges all around it to hold up the side rooms. So the beams of the side rooms did not have to be fixed into the temple wall itself.

fr.L: Et les chambres latérales [étaient] chambre sur chambre, trois [étages], et trente [à chaque étage] ; et [il y avait des retraits] qui entraient dans le mur qui [appartenait] à la maison, pour les chambres latérales, tout autour, pour servir d’appuis, afin qu’elles ne soient pas appuyées dans le mur de la maison.
fr.B: Les chambres latérales étaient sur trois étages, l’une au-dessus de l’autre, trente à chaque étage. Le mur du temple avait des retraits tout autour pour soutenir les chambres latérales, afin que leurs poutres n’aient pas à être encastrées dans le mur même du temple.
fr.R: Les chambres latérales étaient construites sur trois niveaux, les unes au-dessus des autres. Il y avait trente chambres à chaque niveau. Le mur du temple avait des rebords tout autour pour soutenir les chambres latérales. Ainsi, les poutres de ces chambres n’avaient pas besoin d’être fixées dans le mur du temple lui-même.

es.L: Y las cámaras laterales [estaban] cámara lateral sobre cámara lateral, tres [pisos], y treinta en cada piso; y [había rebajos] que entraban en el muro que [pertenecía] a la casa para las cámaras laterales alrededor, para que sirvieran de apoyo, y no estuvieran apoyadas en el muro de la casa.
es.B: Los cuartos laterales estaban en tres pisos, uno encima de otro, treinta en cada piso. El muro del templo tenía rebajos alrededor para sostener los cuartos laterales, de modo que sus vigas no tuvieran que empotrarse en el muro mismo del templo.
es.R: Los cuartos laterales estaban construidos en tres pisos, uno encima de otro. Había treinta cuartos en cada piso. El muro del templo tenía bordes por todo alrededor para sostener los cuartos laterales. Así las vigas de los cuartos laterales no tenían que meterse en el muro mismo del templo.

sw.L: Na vyumba vya pembeni [vilikuwa] chumba juu ya chumba, [ghorofa] tatu, na thelathini katika kila ghorofa; na [vipandio] vilikuwa vikiingia katika ukuta uliokuwa wa nyumba kwa ajili ya vyumba vya pembeni pande zote, ili viwe vishikio, wala visishikiliwe ndani ya ukuta wa nyumba.
sw.B: Vyumba vya pembeni vilikuwa ghorofa tatu, kimoja juu ya kingine, thelathini katika kila ghorofa. Ukuta wa hekalu ulikuwa na vipandio pande zote vya kushikilia vyumba vya pembeni, ili boriti zake zisihitaji kutiwa ndani ya ukuta wa hekalu wenyewe.
sw.R: Vyumba vya pembeni vilijengwa katika ghorofa tatu, kimoja juu ya kingine. Kila ghorofa ilikuwa na vyumba thelathini. Ukuta wa hekalu ulikuwa na vipandio pande zote vya kushikilia vyumba hivyo. Hivyo boriti za vyumba vya pembeni hazikuhitaji kukatiwa ndani ya ukuta wa hekalu wenyewe.

vi.L: Các phòng phụ, phòng phụ chồng trên phòng phụ, [có] ba [tầng], và ba mươi [phòng] mỗi tầng; và [có những gờ] đi vào tường thuộc về nhà dành cho các phòng phụ chung quanh, để làm chỗ tựa, hầu cho chúng không phải tựa vào tường của nhà.
vi.B: Các phòng phụ có ba tầng, tầng này chồng lên tầng kia, mỗi tầng ba mươi phòng. Tường đền thờ có những gờ chung quanh để đỡ các phòng phụ, nhờ vậy các đà không phải gác vào chính tường đền thờ.
vi.R: Các phòng phụ được xây thành ba tầng, tầng này chồng lên tầng kia. Mỗi tầng có ba mươi phòng. Tường đền thờ có những gờ chung quanh để đỡ các phòng phụ. Như vậy các đà của phòng phụ không phải gắn vào chính tường đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 곁방들은 곁방 위에 곁방이 [포개진] 세 [층]이었고, [층마다] 서른 [개]였다. 그리고 [턱이] 곁방들을 위하여 그 집에 딸린 벽 사방으로 들어가 있어서 받침이 되었으니, 그 집의 벽 속에서 받쳐지지 않게 하려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 곁방들은 한 층 위에 또 한 층이 있는 세 층으로 되어 있었고, 층마다 서른 개씩 있었다. 성전 벽에는 곁방들을 받치는 턱이 사방으로 둘려 있어서, 곁방의 들보를 성전 벽 자체에 박아 넣지 않아도 되었다.
ko.R: 곁방들은 세 층으로 지어져 있었다. 한 층 위에 또 한 층이 있었다. 층마다 방이 서른 개씩 있었다. 성전 벽에는 사방으로 턱이 있어서 곁방들을 받쳐 주었다. 그래서 곁방의 들보를 성전 벽 속에 박아 넣을 필요가 없었다.

decisions.choice: three and thirty times: three stories with thirty rooms in each
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "three and thirty times" is usually read as three stories of thirty rooms. The Septuagint reads "thirty-three" twice, and some take the phrase as thirty-three rooms in all.

decisions.choice: going into the wall ... supports: ledges in the temple wall held the beams of the side rooms
decisions.reason: As in Solomon's temple (1 Kings 6:6), the wall of the temple was stepped back at each story, and the beams of the side rooms rested on the steps. The beams did not go into the temple wall itself, so the wall of the holy house was not pierced.

decisions.choice: [ledges] (L); ledges (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "going in". The sense is given by 1 Kings 6:6 (m2).

decisions.choice: "retraits" (L, B) / "rebords" (R) for the ledges
decisions.reason: As the published 1 Kings 6:6, which describes the same construction.

decisions.choice: "[rebajos]" (L); "rebajos" (B); "bordes" (R)
decisions.reason: The same ledges as 1 Kings 6:6, where the published Spanish has "rebajos" at L and B and "borde" at R: the wall steps in at each story and the beams rest on the step.

decisions.choice: vipandio (ledges)
decisions.reason: The word used for the same ledges in the published 1 Kings 6:6.

decisions.choice: "gờ" for the ledges, "đà" for the beams
decisions.reason: The words of 1 Kings 6:6 for the same construction in Solomon's temple.

source.text: וְֽרָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽנָסְבָה֩ לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה לַצְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב־הַ֠בַּיִת לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה סָבִ֤יב׀סָבִיב֙ לַבַּ֔יִת עַל־כֵּ֥ן רֹֽחַב־לַבַּ֖יִת לְמָ֑עְלָה וְכֵ֧ן הַתַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַתִּיכוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was broader and wound around higher and higher to the side chambers, for [the] surrounding of the house [went] higher and higher all around all around the house; therefore [the] breadth of the house [increased] upward, and so from the lowest one went up to the highest by the middle.

en.L: And it became broader as it wound around higher and higher for the side chambers, for the surrounding [structure] of the house [went] higher and higher all around the house; so the breadth of the house [grew] upward, and thus from the lowest [story] one went up to the highest by the middle [one].
en.B: The side rooms became wider at each story going up, because the structure surrounding the temple went up in stages all around it. So the building became wider toward the top, and one went up from the lowest story to the top story through the middle one.
en.R: The side rooms got wider at each level going up, because the temple wall became thinner at each level. So the building was wider at the top. A stairway led from the bottom level through the middle level to the top level.

fr.L: Et [elles] s’élargissaient en tournant de plus en plus haut pour les chambres latérales, car l’entourage de la maison [montait] de plus en plus haut tout autour de la maison ; c’est pourquoi la largeur de la maison [augmentait] vers le haut, et ainsi, depuis [l’étage] inférieur, on montait au plus élevé par celui du milieu.
fr.B: Les chambres latérales étaient plus larges à chaque étage en montant, car la construction qui entourait le temple s’élevait par degrés tout autour. Ainsi le bâtiment s’élargissait vers le haut, et l’on montait de l’étage inférieur à l’étage supérieur en passant par celui du milieu.
fr.R: Les chambres latérales devenaient plus larges à chaque niveau, en montant, parce que le mur du temple devenait plus mince à chaque niveau. Ainsi, le bâtiment était plus large en haut. Un escalier montait du niveau du bas jusqu’au niveau du haut, en passant par celui du milieu.

es.L: Y se ensanchaba y daba vuelta más y más arriba para las cámaras laterales, porque lo que rodeaba la casa [subía] más y más arriba alrededor de la casa; por eso la anchura de la casa [aumentaba] hacia arriba, y así desde el [piso] más bajo se subía al más alto por el del medio.
es.B: Los cuartos laterales eran más anchos en cada piso hacia arriba, porque la estructura que rodeaba el templo subía por escalones alrededor de él. Por eso el edificio era más ancho hacia arriba, y se subía del piso más bajo al piso de arriba pasando por el del medio.
es.R: Los cuartos laterales eran más anchos en cada piso hacia arriba, porque el muro del templo se hacía más delgado en cada piso. Por eso el edificio era más ancho arriba. Una escalera subía desde el piso de abajo, pasando por el del medio, hasta el de arriba.

sw.L: Na ikawa pana zaidi, ikizunguka juu zaidi na juu zaidi kwa ajili ya vyumba vya pembeni, kwa maana [jengo] lililoizunguka nyumba [lilipanda] juu zaidi na juu zaidi pande zote za nyumba; kwa hiyo upana wa nyumba [uliongezeka] kuelekea juu, na hivyo kutoka [ghorofa] ya chini kabisa mtu alipanda mpaka ya juu kabisa kupitia ya katikati.
sw.B: Vyumba vya pembeni vilikuwa vipana zaidi kila ghorofa kwenda juu, kwa sababu jengo lililolizunguka hekalu lilipanda hatua kwa hatua pande zote. Hivyo jengo lilikuwa pana zaidi upande wa juu, na mtu alipanda kutoka ghorofa ya chini mpaka ya juu kupitia ghorofa ya katikati.
sw.R: Vyumba vya pembeni vilizidi kuwa vipana kila ghorofa kwenda juu, kwa sababu ukuta wa hekalu ulipungua unene kila ghorofa. Hivyo jengo lilikuwa pana zaidi juu. Ngazi zilipanda kutoka ghorofa ya chini, kupitia ghorofa ya katikati, mpaka ghorofa ya juu.

vi.L: Và nó rộng hơn khi vòng lên cao dần, cao dần cho các phòng phụ, vì phần bao quanh nhà [đi] lên cao dần, cao dần chung quanh nhà; vì vậy bề rộng của nhà [tăng] lên phía trên, và như thế từ [tầng] thấp nhất người ta đi lên [tầng] cao nhất qua [tầng] giữa.
vi.B: Các phòng phụ rộng dần ra ở mỗi tầng đi lên, vì phần kiến trúc bao quanh đền thờ được xây lên từng bậc chung quanh. Do đó tòa nhà rộng dần về phía trên, và người ta đi từ tầng dưới cùng lên tầng trên cùng qua tầng giữa.
vi.R: Càng lên cao, các phòng phụ càng rộng hơn, vì tường đền thờ ở mỗi tầng mỏng hơn. Vì vậy tòa nhà rộng hơn ở phía trên. Có cầu thang đi từ tầng dưới cùng, qua tầng giữa, lên tầng trên cùng.

ko.L: 그리고 곁방들을 위하여 위로 위로 올라갈수록 [곁방이] 넓어지며 둘러 있었으니, 그 집을 두른 [구조물이] 그 집 사방으로 위로 위로 올라갔기 때문이다. 그러므로 그 집의 너비가 위로 [갈수록 넓어졌고], 그렇게 아래층에서 가운데 [층을] 거쳐 맨 위 [층으로] 올라갔다.
ko.B: 곁방들은 위층으로 올라갈수록 넓어졌다. 성전을 두른 구조물이 사방으로 층층이 올라갔기 때문이다. 그래서 건물은 위로 갈수록 넓어졌고, 아래층에서 가운데층을 거쳐 맨 위층으로 올라가게 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 곁방들은 위층으로 올라갈수록 넓어졌다. 성전 벽이 층마다 조금씩 얇아졌기 때문이다. 그래서 건물은 위쪽이 더 넓었다. 아래층에서 가운데층을 거쳐 맨 위층까지 올라가는 계단이 있었다.

decisions.choice: the rooms widened with each story: the verse is hard and its details uncertain
alternatives: a winding stair led up to the side rooms
decisions.reason: The verse is very hard to construe. The likely sense, from 1 Kings 6:6, is that the temple wall stepped back at each story, so that the side rooms became wider at each level, and that there was a stairway or ramp from the lowest to the top story. Some read "wound around" as a winding stair (as 1 Kings 6:8). The translation keeps the general sense and does not settle the details.

decisions.choice: the temple wall became thinner at each level (R)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the reason for the widening from 1 Kings 6:6 (m1).

source.text: וְרָאִ֧יתִי לַבַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב׀סָבִ֑יב מוּסְד֤וֹת הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַקָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I saw to the house a height all around all around; [the] foundations of the side chambers [were] [the] fullness of the reed, six cubits to the joint.

en.L: And I saw that the house [had] a raised platform all around; the foundations of the side chambers [were] a full reed, six cubits, to the joint.
en.B: I saw that the temple had a raised platform all around it. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed, {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|six cubits}}, to the joint.
en.R: I saw that the temple stood on a raised platform that went all the way around it. The foundations of the side rooms were {{units:about 10 1/2 feet|a reed}} high.

fr.L: Et je vis que la maison [avait] une plate-forme surélevée tout autour ; les fondations des chambres latérales [étaient] un roseau plein, six coudées, jusqu’à la jointure.
fr.B: Je vis que le temple avait une plate-forme surélevée tout autour. Les fondations des chambres latérales mesuraient un roseau entier, {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|six coudées}}, jusqu’à la jointure.
fr.R: J’ai vu que le temple reposait sur une plate-forme surélevée, qui en faisait tout le tour. Les fondations des chambres latérales avaient {{units:environ 3,20 mètres|un roseau}} de haut.

es.L: Y vi que la casa [tenía] una plataforma elevada alrededor; los cimientos de las cámaras laterales [eran] una caña entera, seis codos, hasta la juntura.
es.B: Vi que el templo tenía una plataforma elevada alrededor. Los cimientos de los cuartos laterales medían una caña entera, {{units:unos 3,2 metros|seis codos}}, hasta la juntura.
es.R: Vi que el templo estaba sobre una plataforma elevada que lo rodeaba por completo. Los cimientos de los cuartos laterales tenían {{units:unos 3,2 metros|una caña}} de alto.

sw.L: Nami nikaona kwamba nyumba [ilikuwa na] jukwaa lililoinuka pande zote; misingi ya vyumba vya pembeni [ilikuwa] mwanzi mzima, dhiraa sita, mpaka kiungo.
sw.B: Nikaona kwamba hekalu lilikuwa na jukwaa lililoinuka pande zote. Misingi ya vyumba vya pembeni ilikuwa mwanzi mzima, {{units:karibu mita 3.2|dhiraa sita}}, mpaka kiungo.
sw.R: Nikaona kwamba hekalu lilisimama juu ya jukwaa lililoinuka, lililolizunguka pande zote. Misingi ya vyumba vya pembeni ilikuwa na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 3.2|mwanzi mmoja}}.

vi.L: Tôi thấy nhà [có] một nền cao chung quanh, khắp chung quanh; nền móng của các phòng phụ [là] một cây sậy trọn, sáu cu-đê, đến chỗ nối.
vi.B: Tôi thấy đền thờ có một nền cao chung quanh. Nền móng của các phòng phụ cao trọn một cây sậy, {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|sáu cu-đê}}, tính đến chỗ nối.
vi.R: Tôi thấy đền thờ được xây trên một nền cao bao quanh khắp bốn phía. Nền móng của các phòng phụ cao {{units:khoảng 3,2 m|một cây sậy}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 보니, 그 집에는 사방으로 높은 [단이] 있었고, 곁방들의 기초는 한 갈대 가득, 곧 이음매까지 여섯 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 내가 보니, 성전 둘레에는 사방으로 높은 단이 있었다. 곁방들의 기초는 이음매까지 꼭 한 갈대, 곧 {{units:약 3.2미터|여섯 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 내가 보니, 성전은 사방으로 빙 둘러 높이 쌓은 단 위에 서 있었다. 곁방들의 기초는 높이가 {{units:약 3.2미터|한 갈대}}이었다.

decisions.choice: a height: a raised platform or terrace on which the temple stood
decisions.reason: The word means "height". It is taken to be the base on which the temple and its side rooms stood, six cubits high, so that the house was raised above the inner court.

decisions.choice: to the joint: a hard word, perhaps the corner or edge of the platform
decisions.reason: The word is found only here and in 13:18, where it seems to mean "wrist" or "joint". Here it may mean the edge or corner of the platform. The sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: the foundations were a reed high (R)
decisions.reason: Readable leaves the hard last word (m2) unrendered and gives the measure.

decisions.choice: jukwaa lililoinuka (raised platform)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "a height" is read as a raised platform (meaning decision); "jukwaa" is the ordinary word for a raised base or stage.

source.text: רֹ֣חַב הַקִּ֧יר אֲֽשֶׁר־לַצֵּלָ֛ע אֶל־הַח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] breadth of the wall which [belonged] to the side chamber to the outside [was] five cubits; and what [was] left free between [the] side chambers which [belonged] to the house.

en.L: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers [was] five cubits; and [there was] a free space between the side chambers of the house
en.B: The outer wall of the side rooms was {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} thick. There was an open space between the side rooms of the temple
en.R: The outside wall of the side rooms was {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} thick. There was an open area around the side rooms of the temple,

fr.L: La largeur du mur extérieur des chambres latérales [était de] cinq coudées ; et [il y avait] un espace libre entre les chambres latérales de la maison
fr.B: Le mur extérieur des chambres latérales avait {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} d’épaisseur. Il y avait un espace libre entre les chambres latérales du temple
fr.R: Le mur extérieur des chambres latérales avait {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} d’épaisseur. Il y avait un espace libre autour des chambres latérales du temple,

es.L: La anchura del muro exterior de las cámaras laterales [era] de cinco codos; y [había] un espacio libre entre las cámaras laterales de la casa
es.B: El muro exterior de los cuartos laterales tenía {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de grosor. Había un espacio abierto entre los cuartos laterales del templo
es.R: El muro de afuera de los cuartos laterales tenía {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de grosor. Había un espacio abierto alrededor de los cuartos laterales del templo,

sw.L: Unene wa ukuta wa nje wa vyumba vya pembeni [ulikuwa] dhiraa tano; na [palikuwa na] nafasi wazi kati ya vyumba vya pembeni vya nyumba
sw.B: Ukuta wa nje wa vyumba vya pembeni ulikuwa na unene wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}}. Palikuwa na nafasi wazi kati ya vyumba vya pembeni vya hekalu
sw.R: Ukuta wa nje wa vyumba vya pembeni ulikuwa na unene wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}}. Palikuwa na eneo wazi kuzunguka vyumba vya pembeni vya hekalu,

vi.L: Bề dày của tường ngoài của các phòng phụ [là] năm cu-đê; và [có] một khoảng trống giữa các phòng phụ của nhà
vi.B: Tường ngoài của các phòng phụ dày {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}}. Có một khoảng trống giữa các phòng phụ của đền thờ
vi.R: Tường ngoài của các phòng phụ dày {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}}. Có một khoảng đất trống bao quanh các phòng phụ của đền thờ,

ko.L: 곁방의 바깥쪽 벽의 두께는 다섯 규빗이었고, 그 집의 곁방들 사이에는 비워 둔 [공간이 있었다].
ko.B: 곁방들의 바깥벽은 두께가 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 그리고 성전의 곁방들과
ko.R: 곁방들의 바깥벽은 두께가 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다. 성전 곁방들 둘레에는 빈 터가 있었고,

decisions.choice: what was left free: an open space or terrace left around the building
decisions.reason: The word means "what is left" or "set down". It names an open strip on the platform outside the side rooms (verse 11). Some take the verse to end "between the side rooms of the house and the rooms" with verse 10.

decisions.choice: "khoảng trống" (L, B) / "khoảng đất trống" (R) for the free space
decisions.reason: The plain sense of the word, an open area left around the building; Readable makes clear it is open ground.

source.text: וּבֵ֨ין הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And between the rooms [the] breadth [was] twenty cubits around the house all around all around.

en.L: and the chambers, a width of twenty cubits, all around the house on every side.
en.B: and the rooms; it was {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide all around the temple.
en.R: and beyond it, between the temple and the other rooms, was a space {{units:about 35 feet|twenty cubits}} wide all around the temple.

fr.L: et les chambres, une largeur de vingt coudées, tout autour de la maison, de tous côtés.
fr.B: et les salles ; il avait {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large tout autour du temple.
fr.R: et, au-delà, entre le temple et les autres salles, il y avait un espace qui avait {{units:environ 10,5 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large tout autour du temple.

es.L: y las cámaras, una anchura de veinte codos, alrededor de la casa por todos lados.
es.B: y las salas; tenía {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho alrededor del templo.
es.R: y más allá, entre el templo y las otras salas, había un espacio de {{units:unos 10,5 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho alrededor de todo el templo.

sw.L: na vyumba, upana wa dhiraa ishirini, kuizunguka nyumba pande zote.
sw.B: na vyumba; upana wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}} kulizunguka hekalu pande zote.
sw.R: na zaidi ya hapo, kati ya hekalu na vyumba vingine, palikuwa na nafasi yenye upana wa {{units:karibu mita 11|dhiraa ishirini}} kulizunguka hekalu lote.

vi.L: và các phòng, bề rộng hai mươi cu-đê, chung quanh nhà, khắp chung quanh.
vi.B: và các phòng; khoảng ấy rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} chung quanh đền thờ.
vi.R: và xa hơn nữa, giữa đền thờ và các phòng khác, có một khoảng rộng {{units:khoảng 10,6 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} bao quanh đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 방들 사이에는 그 집 둘레 사방으로 이십 규빗의 너비가 [있었다].
ko.B: 방들 사이에는 빈 터가 있었는데, 그 너비가 성전 둘레 사방으로 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 그 너머, 성전과 다른 방들 사이에는 성전을 빙 둘러 너비가 {{units:약 11미터|이십 규빗}}인 빈 터가 있었다.

decisions.choice: between the rooms: the open space between the temple building and the priests' rooms
decisions.reason: "The rooms" here are not the side rooms of verse 5 but the rooms of the priests in the inner court, described in 42:1-14. A space of twenty cubits separated them from the temple building.

decisions.choice: verses 9 and 10 read as one sentence (all levels)
decisions.reason: The end of verse 9 and verse 10 form one statement about the open space, so every level runs verse 9 into verse 10.

decisions.choice: "chambres" (L) / "salles" (B, R) for the leshakhot, the rooms around the courts, kept apart from the "chambres latérales" of the temple
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the published Jeremiah 35:2.

decisions.choice: "las cámaras" (L); "las salas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The priests' rooms (lishkah) are "cámara" at L and "sala" at B and R throughout chapters 40 to 46, kept apart from the "cuartos laterales" built against the temple wall.

decisions.choice: verse 9 runs on into verse 10 at every level ("giữa ... và các phòng")
decisions.reason: The sentence about the space between the side rooms and the priests' rooms is split by the verse division, as in the English; Vietnamese keeps "giữa ... và ..." across it rather than closing verse 9.

decisions.choice: Verses 9 and 10 kept apart as two Korean sentences at Literal; at Balanced and Readable verse 9 ends open and verse 10 completes it
alternatives: one Korean sentence closed only in verse 10 at every level
decisions.reason: The English reads the two verses as one sentence. Korean is verb-final, so Literal closes each verse on its own, while Balanced and Readable let verse 9's open space be named in verse 10 without moving any words across the verse marker.

source.text: וּפֶ֤תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ לַמֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַדָּר֑וֹם וְרֹ֨חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַמֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] entrance of the side chamber [was] to the free space, one entrance [the] way of the north and one entrance to the south; and [the] breadth of the place of the free space [was] five cubits all around all around.

en.L: And the entrances of the side chambers [opened] onto the free space, one entrance toward the north and one entrance toward the south; and the width of the free space [was] five cubits all around.
en.B: The side rooms had doors opening onto the open space, one door on the north side and one on the south. The open space was {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} wide all around.
en.R: The side rooms had doorways that opened onto the open area. One doorway was on the north side, and one was on the south side. The open area was {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} wide all around.

fr.L: Et les entrées des chambres latérales [donnaient] sur l’espace libre, une entrée vers le nord et une entrée vers le sud ; et la largeur de l’espace libre [était de] cinq coudées tout autour.
fr.B: Les chambres latérales avaient des portes qui donnaient sur l’espace libre, une porte du côté nord et une du côté sud. L’espace libre avait {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large tout autour.
fr.R: Les chambres latérales avaient des portes qui donnaient sur l’espace libre. Une porte était du côté nord, et une autre du côté sud. L’espace libre avait {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} de large tout autour.

es.L: Y las entradas de las cámaras laterales [daban] al espacio libre, una entrada hacia el norte y una entrada hacia el sur; y la anchura del espacio libre [era] de cinco codos alrededor.
es.B: Los cuartos laterales tenían puertas que daban al espacio abierto, una puerta en el lado norte y otra en el lado sur. El espacio abierto tenía {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho por todo alrededor.
es.R: Los cuartos laterales tenían entradas que daban al espacio abierto. Una entrada estaba en el lado norte, y otra en el lado sur. El espacio abierto tenía {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho por todo alrededor.

sw.L: Na milango ya vyumba vya pembeni [ilielekea] nafasi wazi, mlango mmoja upande wa kaskazini na mlango mmoja upande wa kusini; na upana wa nafasi wazi [ulikuwa] dhiraa tano pande zote.

sw.R: Vyumba vya pembeni vilikuwa na milango iliyofunguka kuelekea eneo wazi. Mlango mmoja ulikuwa upande wa kaskazini, na mmoja upande wa kusini. Eneo hilo wazi lilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}} pande zote.

vi.L: Các lối vào của phòng phụ [mở] ra khoảng trống, một lối vào về hướng bắc và một lối vào về hướng nam; và bề rộng của khoảng trống [là] năm cu-đê chung quanh, khắp chung quanh.
vi.B: Các phòng phụ có cửa mở ra khoảng trống, một cửa ở phía bắc và một cửa ở phía nam. Khoảng trống ấy rộng {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}} chung quanh.
vi.R: Các phòng phụ có lối ra vào mở ra khoảng đất trống. Một lối ở phía bắc, và một lối ở phía nam. Khoảng đất trống ấy rộng {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}} khắp chung quanh.

ko.L: 그리고 곁방의 입구들은 비워 둔 [공간] 쪽으로 [나 있었는데], 입구 하나는 북쪽으로, 입구 하나는 남쪽으로 [나 있었다]. 그리고 비워 둔 공간의 너비는 사방으로 다섯 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 곁방들에는 빈 터 쪽으로 난 문이 있었는데, 하나는 북쪽에, 하나는 남쪽에 있었다. 빈 터의 너비는 사방으로 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 곁방들에는 빈 터 쪽으로 열리는 문이 있었다. 문 하나는 북쪽에 있었고, 다른 하나는 남쪽에 있었다. 빈 터는 사방으로 너비가 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다.

source.text: וְהַבִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ־הַיָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְקִ֧יר הַבִּנְיָ֛ן חָֽמֵשׁ־אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב׀סָבִ֑יב וְאָרְכּ֖וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the building which [was] to [the] face of the separate area, [the] side of [the] way of the sea, [the] breadth seventy cubits, and [the] wall of the building five cubits breadth all around all around, and its length ninety cubits.

en.B: The building facing the separate area on the west side was {{units:about 122 1/2 feet|seventy cubits}} wide. Its wall was {{units:about 8 3/4 feet|five cubits}} thick all around, and it was {{units:about 157 1/2 feet|ninety cubits}} long.

fr.L: Et le bâtiment qui [était] en face de l’espace séparé, du côté de l’ouest, [avait] soixante-dix coudées de largeur ; et le mur du bâtiment, cinq coudées d’épaisseur tout autour ; et sa longueur, quatre-vingt-dix coudées.
fr.B: Le bâtiment qui faisait face à l’espace séparé, du côté ouest, avait {{units:environ 37,5 mètres|soixante-dix coudées}} de large. Son mur avait {{units:environ 2,65 mètres|cinq coudées}} d’épaisseur tout autour, et il avait {{units:environ 48 mètres|quatre-vingt-dix coudées}} de long.
fr.R: À l’ouest, derrière le temple, il y avait un espace séparé, avec un bâtiment qui lui faisait face. Le bâtiment avait {{units:environ 37,5 mètres|soixante-dix coudées}} de large et {{units:environ 48 mètres|quatre-vingt-dix coudées}} de long. es.L: Y el edificio que [estaba] frente al área separada, en el lado hacia el occidente, [tenía] setenta codos de anchura; y el muro del edificio, cinco codos de grosor alrededor; y su longitud, noventa codos.
es.B: El edificio que estaba frente al área separada, en el lado occidental, tenía {{units:unos 37 metros|setenta codos}} de ancho. Su muro tenía {{units:unos 2,6 metros|cinco codos}} de grosor por todo alrededor, y medía {{units:unos 47 metros|noventa codos}} de largo.
es.R: En el extremo occidental, detrás del templo, había un área separada con un edificio frente a ella. El edificio tenía {{units:unos 37 metros|setenta codos}} de ancho y {{units:unos 47 metros|noventa codos}} de largo. sw.L: Na jengo lililoelekea eneo lililotengwa upande wa magharibi [lilikuwa] dhiraa sabini upana; na ukuta wa jengo, dhiraa tano unene pande zote; na urefu wake, dhiraa tisini.

Jengo hilo lilikuwa na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 37|dhiraa sabini}} na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 48|dhiraa tisini}}. Kuta zake zilikuwa na unene wa {{units:karibu mita 2.7|dhiraa tano}} pande zote.

vi.L: Tòa nhà [ở] đối diện khu riêng, về phía tây, rộng bảy mươi cu-đê; tường của tòa nhà dày năm cu-đê chung quanh, khắp chung quanh; và chiều dài của nó chín mươi cu-đê.
vi.B: Tòa nhà đối diện khu riêng ở phía tây rộng {{units:khoảng 37 m|bảy mươi cu-đê}}. Tường của nó dày {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}} chung quanh, và nó dài {{units:khoảng 48 m|chín mươi cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Ở đầu phía tây, phía sau đền thờ, có một khu riêng, và một tòa nhà đối diện khu ấy. Tòa nhà rộng {{units:khoảng 37 m|bảy mươi cu-đê}} và dài {{units:khoảng 48 m|chín mươi cu-đê}}. Tường chung quanh dày {{units:khoảng 2,7 m|năm cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 서쪽 편에서 따로 떼어 둔 구역을 마주한 건물은 너비가 칠십 규빗이었고, 그 건물의 벽은 사방으로 두께가 다섯 규빗이었으며, 그 길이는 구십 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 서쪽에서 따로 떼어 둔 구역을 마주하고 있는 건물은 너비가 {{units:약 37미터|칠십 규빗}}이었다. 그 벽은 사방으로 두께가 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었고, 건물의 길이는 {{units:약 48미터|구십 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 성전 뒤쪽 서쪽 끝에는 따로 떼어 둔 구역이 있었고, 그 구역을 마주하고 건물이 하나 있었다. 그 건물은 너비가 {{units:약 37미터|칠십 규빗}}, 길이가 {{units:약 48미터|구십 규빗}}이었다. 그 벽은 사방으로 두께가 {{units:약 2.7미터|다섯 규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: the separate area: an area set apart behind the temple
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning "cut off". It names the area behind the temple building on the west, set apart from the rest of the courts (verses 13-15; 42:1, 10, 13). Whether it is an open yard or a building plot is not certain.

decisions.choice: the way of the sea: west
decisions.reason: Israel's sea, the Mediterranean, lies to the west, so "toward the sea" means "toward the west".

decisions.choice: the building: a large building of unknown use behind the temple
decisions.reason: The text does not say what the building on the west was for. It may have been for storage or for the temple's service; 2 Kings 23:11 and 1 Chronicles 26:18 speak of a structure on the west side of Solomon's temple.

decisions.choice: the separate area (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same English is used for this word through chapters 41-42.

decisions.choice: "l'espace séparé" for the gizrah at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; the word is uncertain (see the English footnote), and French keeps a plain description like the English "separate area".

decisions.choice: "el área separada" (all levels)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (gizrah) means something cut off or set apart; whether it was an open yard or an enclosed space is not known. "Área separada" keeps the sense without deciding, and is used in chapters 41 and 42.

decisions.choice: eneo lililotengwa (every level)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gizrah is an area set apart behind the temple; its exact nature is uncertain (meaning decision). "Eneo lililotengwa" says only that it was set apart, as the English "the separate area"; used through chapter 42.

decisions.choice: "khu riêng" for gizrah at every level
decisions.reason: The word means a place cut off or set apart; "khu riêng" keeps that without guessing at its use, and is used for every occurrence in chapters 41-42.

decisions.choice: "따로 떼어 둔 구역" at every level for the separate area
decisions.reason: The word means a piece cut off or set apart; the term sheet keeps one plain phrase at every level so the area is recognised each time it recurs (41:12-15; 42:1, 10, 13).

decisions.choice: "서쪽" at every level for "the way of the sea"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom names the west by the Mediterranean; Korean says the direction, as the English does at every level.

source.text: וּמָדַ֣ד אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַגִּזְרָ֤ה וְהַבִּנְיָה֙ וְקִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔יהָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he measured the house, length a hundred cubits, and the separate area and the building and its walls, length a hundred cubits.

en.L: And he measured the house, a hundred cubits long; and the separate area and the building with its walls, a hundred cubits long.
en.B: Then he measured the temple: it was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long. The separate area with the building and its walls was also {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long.
en.R: Then he measured the temple. It was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long. The separate area, with the building and its walls, was also {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} long.

fr.L: Et il mesura la maison : cent coudées de long ; et l’espace séparé, et le bâtiment avec ses murs : cent coudées de long.
fr.B: Puis il mesura le temple : il avait {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de long. L’espace séparé, avec le bâtiment et ses murs, avait aussi {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de long.
fr.R: Ensuite, il a mesuré le temple. Il avait {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de long. L’espace séparé, avec le bâtiment et ses murs, avait aussi {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de long.

es.L: Y midió la casa, cien codos de longitud; y el área separada y el edificio con sus muros, cien codos de longitud.
es.B: Luego midió el templo: tenía {{units:unos 53 metros|100 codos}} de largo. El área separada, con el edificio y sus muros, tenía también {{units:unos 53 metros|100 codos}} de largo.
es.R: Después midió el templo. Tenía {{units:unos 53 metros|100 codos}} de largo. El área separada, con el edificio y sus muros, tenía también {{units:unos 53 metros|100 codos}} de largo.

sw.L: Akaipima nyumba, urefu dhiraa mia moja; na eneo lililotengwa na jengo pamoja na kuta zake, urefu dhiraa mia moja.
sw.B: Kisha akalipima hekalu: urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 53|dhiraa 100}}. Eneo lililotengwa pamoja na jengo na kuta zake nalo lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 53|dhiraa 100}}.
sw.R: Kisha akalipima hekalu. Lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 53|dhiraa 100}}. Eneo lililotengwa, pamoja na jengo na kuta zake, nalo lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 53|dhiraa 100}}.

vi.L: Người đo nhà, dài 100 cu-đê; và khu riêng cùng tòa nhà với các tường của nó, dài 100 cu-đê.
vi.B: Rồi người đo đền thờ: dài {{units:khoảng 53 m|100 cu-đê}}. Khu riêng cùng tòa nhà và các tường của nó cũng dài {{units:khoảng 53 m|100 cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Rồi người đo đền thờ. Đền thờ dài {{units:khoảng 53 m|100 cu-đê}}. Khu riêng, cùng với tòa nhà và các tường của nó, cũng dài {{units:khoảng 53 m|100 cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 집을 재니 길이가 100규빗이었고, 따로 떼어 둔 구역과 그 건물과 그 벽들도 길이가 100규빗이었다.
ko.B: 그다음에 그가 성전을 재니, 길이가 {{units:약 53미터|100규빗}}이었다. 따로 떼어 둔 구역과 그 건물과 그 벽들까지 합한 길이도 {{units:약 53미터|100규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 그다음에 그는 성전을 쟀다. 성전의 길이는 {{units:약 53미터|100규빗}}이었다. 따로 떼어 둔 구역은 그 건물과 벽들까지 합하여 길이가 역시 {{units:약 53미터|100규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: a hundred cubits: the temple and its surroundings are laid out in squares of a hundred cubits
decisions.reason: The temple building is a hundred cubits long, and the inner court and the area behind the temple are each a hundred cubits square (40:47; verse 14). The repeated hundred stresses order and completeness.

en.L: And the width of the front of the house and of the separate area toward the east [was] a hundred cubits.
en.B: The width of the temple's front, together with the separate area, on the east side was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}}.
en.R: The front of the temple on the east side, together with the separate areas beside it, was {{units:about 175 feet|100 cubits}} wide.

fr.B: La façade du temple, avec l’espace séparé, du côté est, avait {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de large.
fr.R: Du côté est, la façade du temple, avec les espaces séparés qui se trouvaient à côté, avait {{units:environ 53 mètres|100 coudées}} de large.

decisions.choice: galleries: a hard word, perhaps terraces, balconies or passages
decisions.reason: The word is found only in Ezekiel (here, verse 16 and 42:3, 5). It seems to name a structure that stepped back in stages, such as terraced balconies or galleries. The exact sense is unknown.

decisions.choice: the inner hall and the porches of the court: the sentence runs on into verse 16
decisions.reason: The end of the verse begins a list of the parts of the temple that were paneled, which continues in verse 16. "The inner hall" may be the main hall and the inner room together. The Hebrew is very compressed.

decisions.choice: galleries (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same English is used for this word in verse 16 and 42:3, 5.

decisions.choice: "vestibule" for the 'ulam and "parvis" for the court, at every level, throughout chapters 41-48
decisions.reason: "Vestibule" is the word of the published 1 Kings 6:3 where the English has "porch"; the term sheet sets "le parvis extérieur / intérieur" for the courts.

decisions.choice: roshani (galleries)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is hard (meaning decision: terraces, balconies or passages); "roshani", a raised gallery or balcony, is as open as the English "galleries".

decisions.choice: baraza, mabaraza (porch, porches)
decisions.reason: The porch ('ulam) is "baraza" at every level, as 1 Kings 6:3 and the term sheet; "ukumbi" is kept for the main hall.

decisions.choice: "hành lang" for 'attiq (galleries)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is rare and its sense uncertain (terraces, balconies or passages); "hành lang" is the most general of these and is used for every occurrence in chapters 41-42.

decisions.choice: "tiền sảnh" for 'ulam (the porch) at every level
decisions.reason: The word of 1 Kings 6:3 for the porch of Solomon's temple, used throughout Ezekiel 40-48.

decisions.choice: "회랑" at every level for the galleries
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is uncertain (a meaning decision gives terraces, balconies or passages). 회랑 is a plain Korean word for a covered walkway or gallery and is used at every level, as the English keeps "galleries".

records.literal_gloss: the thresholds and the closed windows and the galleries all around to [the] three of them opposite the threshold [were] paneled with wood all around all around, and from the ground to the windows, and the windows [were] covered,

en.L: the thresholds, the recessed windows and the galleries all around the three of them, opposite the threshold, [were] paneled with wood all around, from the ground to the windows; and the windows [were] covered,
en.B: the thresholds, the recessed windows, and the galleries around all three of them were paneled with wood all around, from the floor up to the windows. The windows were covered,

fr.L: les seuils, les fenêtres en retrait et les galeries tout autour de [ces] trois, en face du seuil, [étaient] lambrissés de bois tout autour, depuis le sol jusqu’aux fenêtres ; et les fenêtres [étaient] couvertes,
fr.B: les seuils, les fenêtres en retrait et les galeries qui entouraient ces trois parties étaient lambrissés de bois tout autour, depuis le sol jusqu’aux fenêtres. Les fenêtres étaient couvertes,

es.R: las entradas, las ventanas de marco profundo y las galerías alrededor de los tres estaban cubiertas con paneles de madera por todo alrededor, desde el suelo hasta las ventanas. Las ventanas también estaban cubiertas.

vi.B: các ngưỡng cửa, các cửa sổ khung lõm, và các hành lang chung quanh cả ba nơi ấy đều được ốp gỗ khắp chung quanh, từ nền lên đến các cửa sổ. Các cửa sổ đều được che lại,
vi.R: các lối ra vào, các cửa sổ đặt sâu trong khung, và các hành lang chung quanh cả ba nơi ấy đều được ốp ván gỗ khắp chung quanh, từ nền lên đến các cửa sổ. Các cửa sổ cũng được che lại.

ko.L: 문지방들과 틀이 붙박인 창문들과 그 셋을 둘러싼 회랑들은 문지방 맞은편으로 사방에 나무 널판이 입혀져 [있었는데], 땅에서부터 창문들까지 [그러했다]. 그리고 창문들은 덮여 있었다.
ko.B: 문지방들과 틀을 깊이 들인 창문들과 그 세 곳을 둘러싼 회랑들은 사방으로 바닥에서 창문까지 나무 널판으로 입혀져 있었다. 창문들도 덮여 있었다.
ko.R: 문간들과 틀 안에 깊숙이 들어간 창문들과 세 곳을 둘러싼 회랑들은 바닥에서 창문 높이까지 사방으로 나무 널빤지로 덮여 있었다. 창문들도 덮여 있었다.

decisions.choice: paneled with wood: covered with wooden boards
decisions.reason: The word is rare. Solomon's temple too was lined with cedar boards on the inside, from the floor to the ceiling (1 Kings 6:15).

decisions.choice: the windows were covered: perhaps with lattice work or with panels
decisions.reason: The word means "covered". The windows may have been covered with lattices, or the paneling may have run up to and around them. It is not certain.

decisions.choice: recessed windows (L, B); windows set deep in their frames (R)
decisions.reason: As in 40:16.

decisions.choice: "ventanas empotradas" (L, B); "ventanas de marco profundo" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "closed" windows, probably windows set deep in narrowing frames. "Empotradas" says that they are set into the wall; R describes the frame.

decisions.choice: madirisha yaliyoingia ndani (Literal, Balanced); madirisha yaliyowekwa ndani kabisa ya fremu zake (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published 1 Kings 6:4 for the same kind of window; "kizingiti" (threshold) is the word for saf through chapters 40-48.

decisions.choice: "cửa sổ khung lõm" (L, B) / "cửa sổ đặt sâu trong khung" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:4 B describes the same kind of window ("cửa sổ có khung lõm vào"); Readable spells out the picture.

decisions.choice: "틀이 붙박인 창문" (L); "틀을 깊이 들인 창문" (B); "틀 안에 깊숙이 들어간 창문" (R)
decisions.reason: The same windows and the same wording as Korean 1 Kings 6:4, so the two temples can be compared.

source.text: עַל־מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֡תַח וְעַד־הַבַּיִת֩ הַפְּנִימִ֨י וְלַח֜וּץ וְאֶל־כָּל־הַקִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב׀סָבִ֛יב בַּפְּנִימִ֥י וּבַחִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת׃

en.L: to the space above the entrance, both into the inner room and outside, and on all the walls all around, inside and outside, by measure.

sw.L: mpaka nafasi iliyo juu ya mlango, ndani ya chumba cha ndani na nje, na juu ya kuta zote pande zote, ndani na nje, kwa vipimo.

vi.L: đến chỗ phía trên lối vào, cả vào nhà bên trong lẫn bên ngoài, và trên khắp tường chung quanh, bên trong và bên ngoài, theo kích thước.

vi.R: Ván ốp lên đến phía trên lối vào phòng trong, và cả bên ngoài nữa. Tất cả các tường chung quanh, bên trong và bên ngoài, đều được ốp những tấm ván cùng cỡ,

ko.B: 입구 위쪽, 곧 안쪽 방으로 들어가는 곳과 그 바깥쪽까지 그러했다. 사방의 모든 벽에는 안쪽과 바깥쪽 모두 치수를 맞춘 널판이 대어져 있었고,
